seoTitle: How to Set the Correct Time Zone in TradingView
metaDescription: Learn how to change your chart time zone in TradingView, understand exchange time vs local time, and fix candle misalignment for accurate analysis.
intro: When your chart's candles don't line up with your local market hours, the time zone setting is usually the culprit. This guide covers how to change the time zone in TradingView, the difference between exchange time and local time, and how this setting affects candle and indicator alignment. It's aimed at intraday and swing traders who need their sessions to line up correctly.

steps.heading: Open chart settings
steps.body: Access the chart settings menu in TradingView where time zone options are located.

steps.heading: Change the time zone
steps.body: Select your preferred time zone from the available list to update how times are displayed on your chart.

steps.heading: Understand exchange time vs local time
steps.body: Exchange time reflects the trading venue's own local time, while your local time zone setting adjusts the display to match your own location.

steps.heading: See how time zone affects candles and indicators
steps.body: Switching time zones can shift how candles are grouped, especially on higher timeframes, so double-check your setup after making a change.

steps.heading: Avoid common mistakes with time settings
steps.body: Be aware that mismatched time zones can cause session-based indicators or analysis to appear misaligned if not set correctly.

faq.question: Why do my candles look shifted after changing symbols?
faq.answer: Different symbols can trade on different exchanges with their own local hours, so switching between them may require rechecking your time zone setting.

faq.question: Should I use exchange time or my local time zone?
faq.answer: This depends on personal preference; some traders prefer exchange time for consistency with market hours, while others prefer their own local time for convenience.

faq.question: Does the time zone setting affect indicator calculations?
faq.answer: Time zone settings mainly affect how time is displayed and how candles are grouped on certain timeframes, rather than the core calculation logic of most indicators.

faq.question: Will my time zone setting be saved for future sessions?
faq.answer: Yes, once you set your preferred time zone and save your chart layout, it should persist the next time you open TradingView.
